# PhotoSwipe 5.4.4

Unmodified distribution files from the official `photoswipe@5.4.4` npm package.

- Project: https://github.com/dimsemenov/PhotoSwipe
- Documentation: https://photoswipe.com/
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/photoswipe/-/photoswipe-5.4.4.tgz
- License: MIT, included in `LICENSE`.

The npm package archive's SHA-512 integrity was verified against the versioned registry metadata before extracting these files. The files are served locally and copied into the static stream by `Sync-StreamAppearance.ps1`; visitors do not need a CDN or npm at runtime. Application-specific configuration and light colors are in `moments.js` and `moments.css`.
